title: [review] message.rs:562: Missing prefix_len validation
description: RplTarget::write_to computes nbytes = div_ceil(prefix_len, 8) without validating prefix_len <= 128. If prefix_len > 128, then nbytes > 16, and the slice self.prefix[..nbytes] at line 574 will panic because prefix is only [u8; 16]. While from_bytes validates this (line 550-552), direct construction of RplTarget with invalid prefix_len followed by write_to causes an unhandled panic. Should add: if self.prefix_len > 128 { return Err(RplError::InvalidOption); }
